purpose: Test whether bounded agent review improves research correctness and reproducibility enough to justify its cost.
target_interpretation: 10-20 percent profit in every calendar year; a research aspiration, not a guarantee
activation_requires: Exact task and eligible data/universe packet selected and hashed
Training, validation and evaluation boundaries fixed with known-history disclosure
Specifications, prompts, model versions, parameter sets and code frozen
Numerical call/token/cost ceilings and provider capability verified
Independent accounting and causality checks defined
Cash precision/rounding, fractional-stock and integer-option sizing/execution assumptions declared
Immutable result/failure and usage records implemented
expense_allocation: Each expense counted once. Actual billed cost and shadow replacement cost are separate economic scenarios; one-time development cost disclosed separately.
forbidden_interpretations: Known historical data is an untouched holdout
Trade PnL divided by1000 is funded-account return
More searched variants establish stronger evidence
A proposed JSON policy is an enforced runtime limit
